Walmart's net income attributable to Walmart fell about 10.3% from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025. I'm working from memory of the reported figures, so treat the inputs as approximate.

- Fiscal Q1 2025 (quarter ended April 30, 2024): about $5,098 million.
- Fiscal Q4 2025 (quarter ended January 31, 2025): about $4,571 million.

Change = (4,571 − 5,098) / 5,098 ≈ −10.3%

I used the attributable-to-Walmart figure rather than consolidated net income (which includes noncontrolling interests). The consolidated percentage change would likely be similar, but I haven't checked it.
